arguments.query: select b.*, c.charge_id, c.state, c.idempotency_key from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where b.status!="confirmed"
select event_id,payload,status,attempts from outbox where status!="delivered" and (payload not like "{%" or payload like "%schema_version\": 2%" or event_id like "%a9429573%") limit 30
select event_id,substr(payload,1,120) p,status,attempts from outbox where status="pending" order by event_id limit 8
select event_id,booking_id,replace(replace(payload,char(10)," "),"  ","") p from outbox where status="pending" and attempts<=10 and event_id<"evt_00000349" order by event_id
select service,status,message,count(*) n from (select * from request_logs order by id desc limit 120) group by 1,2,3

select "nohold" k,count(*) from bookings b where status="confirmed" and not exists(select 1 from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) union all select "nocheckin",count(*) from bookings b where status="confirmed" and not exists(select 1 from checkins c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) union all select "badcharge",count(*) from bookings b where status="confirmed" and (select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and c.state="captured")!=1 union all select "orphan",count(*) from charges c where not exists(select 1 from bookings b where b.booking_id=c.booking_id) union all select "dupref",count(*) from (select client_reference from bookings where status="confirmed" and client_reference is not null group by 1 having count(*)>1) union all select "nonconf_charge",count(*) from charges c join bookings b using(booking_id) where b.status!="confirmed" and c.state!="captured" union all select "quar",count(*) from outbox where status="quarantined" union all select "refunds",count(*) from refunds
select id,service,path,status,message from request_logs where status>=400 and id>(select max(id)-160 from request_logs) order by id desc limit 25
